_summary.text: Use Date Picker for date input.

_text.text: The measurement is determined by the type attribute. You can enable quick options via shortcuts property. The disabled date is set by disabledDate, which is a function.

_summary.text: You can choose week, month, year, quarter or multiple dates by extending the standard date picker component.
Picking a date range is supported.

_text.text: When in range mode, the left and right panels are linked by default. If you want the two panels to switch current months independently, you can use the unlink-panels attribute.

_summary.text: Picking a month range is supported.

_text.text: When in range mode, the left and right panels are linked by default. If you want the two panels to switch current years independently, you can use the unlink-panels attribute.

_summary.text: Picking a year range is supported.

_text.text: When in range mode, the left and right panels are linked by default. If you want the two panels to switch years independently, you can use the unlink-panels attribute.

_summary.text: Picking a quarter range is supported.
By default date picker ranges have two panels. If you want one panel set the single-panel attribute.
If user hasn't picked a date, shows today's calendar by default. You can use default-value to set another date. Its value should be parsable by new Date().

_text.text: If type is daterange, default-value sets the left side calendar.

_summary.text: Use format to control displayed text's format in the input box. Use value-format to control binding value's format.

_text.text: By default, the component accepts and emits a Date object.
Check the list here of all available formats of Day.js.
